name: own-hub-rules-tests
description: Firestore security-rules suite for Own Hub. Runs against the already-running emulator.

scripts.test:storage: cd storage && cp ../../../firebase/storage.rules storage.rules.copy && PATH=${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21}/bin:$PATH firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.json --project demo-own-hub --only storage 'node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec ./storage.test.js'
